title: Dashboard-group resources: storage options live in named per-resource helpers, scoped via StorageOptsGetterFor
answers: Where do I add storage options for a new resource in the dashboard API group?
How to register storage for a new dashboard-group resource like variables/notebooks/snapshots
body:
Convention: each resource in the dashboard group (six dashboard versions plus library panels/variables/notebooks/snapshots sharing one group) has its own named *StorageOpts() helper in pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/register.go (dashboardStorageOpts, libraryPanelStorageOpts, variableStorageOpts, notebookStorageOpts, snapshotStorageOpts) rather than an inline apistore.StorageOptions literal at the call site.
Each helper is wired in via opts.StorageOptsGetterFor(resourceInfo, xStorageOpts()) at the point storageForVersion/UpdateAPIGroupInfo installs that resource, pairing the options with the GVK of the version being installed. Do not use the GroupResource-keyed opts.StorageOptsRegister (can't carry a version) or the bare opts.OptsGetter (no per-resource GVK) for anything new here - a resource added without a declared GVK can be persisted as some other kind in the group.
Tests: TestOtherDashboardGroupResourcesDeclareGVK (pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/register_test.go) asserts each helper's resourceInfo.GroupVersionKind() reaches storage and that folder-support flags match intent - follow that pattern for new resources.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/dashboard package when adding or modifying a resource's storage registration
